text_block_list.text:
In between working on the "Ramen Jamboree," I finally set to work on making the "Ultimate Ramen" for Sensei.
............However.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, hmm?
It's finished for the most part, but the plating is...
choice_data_list: How should I put it... it's pretty cluttered.
How should I put it... it's pretty cluttered.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Could it be the arrangement of the toppings?
It feels a bit like the noodles are just floating in the soup, too—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...If we're calling it the 'ultimate ramen',
we definitely want the presentation to look professional, right?"
—A few days later. I went to a ramen shop run by an acquaintance to receive some culinary training.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
There are plenty of tricks, but... well, the quickest way
is to straighten out the noodles nicely.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
See how the noodles are aligned neatly in the bowl? That's the key.
Then you arrange the toppings facing the same direction as the noodles, adjusting so a bit of noodle shows through—see?
choice_data_list: Incredible! This is ramen made by a TRUE pro.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
"Well, practice makes perfect.
I'll teach you how, so just give it a try first."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Swirl the noodles in the hot water.
Hook them with chopsticks, then shake and even them out...
(Splash!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, not again...!
No matter how many times I try, the noodles keep slipping off my chopsticks...

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
You hold your chopsticks nicely, but...
Are you not putting enough pressure on them?
...Oh. That's pretty good, Trainer.
choice_data_list: I think I'm starting to get the hang of it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... As expected of you, Trainer!
...All right, I can still keep going too!

(Splash!)
(Splosh!)
(Sploosh!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
That's enough for today.
Well... everyone has their strengths and weaknesses. Wouldn't it be better to leave it to your Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No. I will definitely master it as well.
...Because I don't want to hold back any effort I can make for you, Sensei.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for teaching me so many things!
I'll keep on practicing!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...Even though I said that, I haven't been able to make any time at all~~!

On top of her usual busy schedule with academics and training,
she also had preparations for the 'Ramen Jamboree.'

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I want to see an example at the shop one more time,
but time is really... ugh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! I need to head back to the dorms soon!
Well then, Trainer, see you tomorrow!

I wave at her back as she hurries away...
and then sink into deep thought.
choice_data_list: If you need an example, could it be...

text_block_list.text: —A few days later. I called Narita Top Road into the Tracen Academy kitchen.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Could those tools happen to be...?

Saying so, she scooped up the pre-boiled noodles
and deftly arranged them into neat, orderly folds.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... It's so beautiful!
You've mastered it completely, haven't you...!
choice_data_list: Well? Think I can be a good role model for you?
How's this? Think I could serve as a good role model for you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
A role model, you say...?
Trainer, is that why you...?
choice_data_list: Well, I am your senior disciple, after all.
Well, I am your senior disciple, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(Even though you're so busy yourself...
Doing all this for me...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
...You're really, truly so dependable!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I—I will master this no matter what!
Could you please show me one more time?
choice_data_list: Of course, as many times as it takes!

text_block_list.text: Early one morning, some time after that. My smartphone chimed with an incoming message.

text_block_list.name: LANE from Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Look, Trainer!
The noodles are arranged so neatly and beautifully!"

text_block_list.name: LANE from Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so sorry, it was still early in the morning...
I only realized after hitting send.
I'm truly sorry...!"
